#37 Irrespective of the above discussion, our colors upon mouse hovering need fixing. On mouse-over the background of a link turns black (or dark blue). I don’t find this nice in general, but specifically for external links which are darker in themselves it makes the appearance of just one big black box with no discernible text left. (Check what I dropped into the Sandbox just now.)

But somehow I don’t see which line in our CSS causes this.(?)
subject: hyperlink design
